dedupe_keys.name: automts fully autonomous processing of multivariate time series data from heterogeneous sensor networks

description: AutoMTS implements automatic method assessment, parameter selection and cleaning of multivariate time series, including imputation and point/segment outlier treatment. It is evaluated on heterogeneous sensors from two water-distribution systems, which establishes its concrete infrastructure-input preparation role. The thesis also discusses historical and real-time settings. The source’s parameter-free claim concerns user-facing selection principles, not proof that internal methods lack parameters. The metadata catalogue identifies a public Python repository and GNU General Public licence without a version; GitHub detects no standard licence, so exact terms remain unverified. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
